_comment: Two-stage coupled differential buffer (BAG clk_diff_inv_coupled_chain, bag3_digital inv_diff_chain). Rows top first, each mirrored about its centre: a p-chain device left, its n-chain twin right (the coupling inverters of each stage, ALIGN's cross-coupled pairs, at mirrored places), the unpaired devices in the middle: the inverters' PMOS, the coupling PMOS, the coupling NMOS, the inverters' NMOS. Netlist (per PDK): written by flow.delay.subckt (chain2_coupled).
